items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: He said, Lou is the manager of Norris. He said, Lou is the manager.

ctx.x: That's what I heard. He just started pretty late. He was not.

He was no reputation. So I'm the one that started Joe Oliver off from being a butler on third and magazine. He was the butler that when I got him. And I put him and we made up the Magnolia Band. And after we made up the Magnolia Band, Joe Oliver takes and we were figuring on getting uniforms. And Noah Dutrae was playing trambor. Sam Dutrae was playing clarinet. What's the name again? Little Happy was playing drum. I was playing guitar. Red Happy? Red Happy was playing drum. And I was playing guitar with him. And…
Well, he's all right, but he doesn't have much depth anymore.
